ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms privilege scopes, isolation boundaries and the cross-tenant flag are declared; it does not test compromise.
offer: Bound the damage from a compromised identity with explicit privilege and isolation scopes. Cross-tenant access defeats the intended blast-radius boundary.

minimal.reason: List the privilege scopes an identity can hold. Without them the blast radius is unknown, so enumerate each scope.

mid.reason: List the isolation boundaries, such as tenant or network separation. An unnamed boundary is not enforced, so declare it.

maximal.reason: Set cross-tenant access to false. Access across tenants defeats the boundary, so deny it.
